learner_operation: Normalize derivative coefficient, distinguish linear-in-y and single-power dependence, classify a three-equation subset.
eligible_role_reasoning: All pure-power rows with distinct nonunit alternative exponents can have a normalized linear term or not, so these truth assignments must vary. Every such row takes both roles in boundary sample.
A fixed nonpower row retains an intended obstruction: recognizing sin(y), cos(y), log(y) as nonmonomials is part of the skill. It need not become true within that template.
Radio banks bound expressible responses; they are preserved in full rather than changing response contract. Every feasible response in the source bank and fixed mathematical backbone is sampled.
No demand for all real exponents or arbitrary x functions: finite source functions with small coefficient scaling and decisive exponent changes already require repeated classification.
Easy derivative coefficient stays 1; moderate division stays within simple powers. Three equations and existing choices preserve workload.
out_of_scope: No integration, substitution, systems, additional derivatives, or new response operations introduced. Positive domain is explicit, so radical rewrites/divisions are valid.
limits: Canonical example lacks answer bank; two legacy drafts lack keys and solutions. No full-bank replay is claimed for those three incomplete records.
